description: Special Water Supply Catchment Areas is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. Based on PWSC100 Layer from 1 JAN 1992. Edited NOV 2021 to include updated declaration boundaries. The layer name changed to SWSCA100 to reflect the legislation terminology and updates. Full release 1 SEP 2023 with further attribute update in AUG 2023. Coverage: Victoria. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. Its tags are Inland waters. It offers 9 resource(s) in dwg, dxf, extended tab, gdb, mif. The portal shows 2026-07-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
